description: Lay a map of the land drawn to scale (survey map, site plan, sketch with its lengths) that the designer attached in the chat under the garden, as a map background. Either `matches`: two or more points on the map matched to the same points in the garden (garden metres, e.g. boundary corners from get_garden_info) — scale, turn and position are fitted; from three matches you get how far each lands from its garden point. Or `measure` (a plot with no place or boundary): two points on the map and the real distance between them — the map lies to scale, as drawn, `from` at `at`. Pick points far apart, zoom_image to place them exactly, then check with capture_preview. Laying again replaces the map. The next save keeps it with the garden, in the place of a kept cadastral map (which can still be downloaded and shown).
